senses.gloss: m. (inf. Hif. of כּוּן, used as a technical term with ref. to הכינו, Ex. XVI, 5) preparing, designation for use on the Sabbath or Holy Day.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:6:2">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᵇ</cite> there is nothing that exists in the shape in which it is used, <he>ואינו בהָכֵנוֹ</he> which may not be considered as designated for use (on the Sabbath &c.). Y. Bets. 62ᵃ top <he>ספק ה׳</he> where there is a doubt as to whether a thing has been ready for use when the festive day began.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>הגוי צריך ה׳</he> that which a gentile offers on a Holy Day requires designation in due time. Ib. I, beg. 60ᵃ <he>בהָכֵינָהּ של אמה</he> because its mother (the hen) was designated for slaughter on the Holy Day; a. fr. [In Babli <cite ref="E00517"><he>הֲכָנָה</he></cite>.]
